description: 3D Plus SA is a Thalès spin-off. The 3D interconnection technologies developed by the company enable stacking of hybrid components (memory, microprocessors, etc.) in embedded electronic systems, to save space, improve performance and enhance system robustness.
AB Tasty supports e-commerce sites, interactive service publishers and media companies to improve their conversion rate and UX/UI optimization.

Loss of tissue functionality or organ failure is often a result of inflammatory, metabolic, and fibrotic processes which can occur in a variety of difficult-to-treat diseases. AgomAb aims to resolve these processes by modulating specific regenerative pathways in the target tissue or throughout the body, ultimately leading to a structural repair of tissue and the restoration of organ function.

Aldebaran Robotics was one of Europe’s earliest and boldest robotics pioneers, and for a time one of the few companies anywhere in the world bringing humanoid robots out of research labs and into real-life use cases. Founded in France in 2005 by Bruno Maisonnier, the company gained international recognition with Nao, a programmable humanoid robot adopted by universities, laboratories, and developers worldwide. It later expanded its ambition with Romeo, designed for assistance and companion applications. Aldebaran embodied a rare European attempt to build a global robotics champion, and its journey culminated in its sale to SoftBank, laying the foundations for SoftBank Robotics.

arGEN-X is a research-stage biopharmaceutical company with a broadly applicable, proprietary platform called SIMPLE Antibody™. Using this platform, arGEN-X is able to create a wide range of monoclonal antibody leads against a broad range of human disease targets. These antibodies are then given highly competitive properties using other technologies in many cases. The company has proven the benefits of its monoclonal antibody development platform by signing numerous partnerships and pursuing two proprietary clinical programmes.

ARX Robotics develops a cost-effective, modular and autonomous robotic platform. The company’s unmanned ground vehicles (“UGVs”) enhance safety and productivity by performing tasks in hazardous, challenging, or labour-intensive environments where human presence is limited or impractical.
founders: Marc Wietfeld, Maximilian Wied, Stefan Röbel

description: Caracol is a leading provider of large-format additive manufacturing solutions. Founded in 2015, the company has developed a proprietary 3D printing technology that enables the production of complex, lightweight components for industrial applications across sectors such as aerospace, energy, marine, and automotive. By combining advanced engineering with sustainable production methods, Caracol helps manufacturers overcome the limitations of traditional fabrication processes.

Carbyon's direct air capture (DAC) uses an innovative patented technology to capture CO2 directly from the atmosphere. This ‘fast swing’ technology increases CO2 capacity and ensures rapid operation speed, thereby significantly driving down unit, energy, and project costs – all critical criteria to facilitate large-scale deployment. Proxima Fusion helps accelerate the transition to sustainable power by providing a path to safe, continuous, and carbon-free electricity at scale. By combining cutting-edge physics with industrial engineering, it transforms the challenge of fusion energy into a competitive advantage for global energy systems.
founders: Hans De Neve, Tessel Jarigsma, Reinier Zoomers

description: Corteria Pharmaceuticals is a French biotechnology company specialized in the development of transformativeTtherapies for the treatment of worsening and acute decompensated heart failure and obesity with established complications.

DenyAll was a French cybersecurity software company founded in 2001, specializing in next-generation application security. The company developed solutions to detect vulnerabilities, protect infrastructure against sophisticated application-layer attacks, and secure interactions between users, applications, and web services. Headquartered in Sèvres, with operations in Montpellier and Germany, DenyAll built a footprint across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, securing more than 60,000 applications. Its customer base included a significant share of CAC 40 and Euronext companies. Following the 2014 acquisition of BeeWare, its main European rival, DenyAll emerged as a leading independent European application-security platform before its sale to Rohde & Schwarz.

Founded in June 2000, DiBcom is a French semiconductor company based on a fabless (no factory) model, that designs, manufactures and sells integrated circuits for receiving Digital Terrestrial television. DiBcom’s solution can be used in any type of terminal and ensures perfect reception of television channels in every situation–including on the move–irrespective of the standard used.
DiogenX, is a preclinical stage biotech company specializing in the development of pancreatic beta-cell modulators for the treatment of type one diabetes (T1D).
founders: Patrick Collombat, Benjamin Charles and Jean-Pascal Tranié

description: Energy supplier in France to businesses, local authorities and consumers.

Created in 2014 and based in Lyon (France), and Boston (USA), Elistair designs and manufactures tethered drone solutions for tactical surveillance and civil defense missions. Elistair’s products are used by armed forces, civil security services and a number of private companies, in more than 60 countries.
founders: Guilhem de Marliave and Timothée Penet

description: Emulation and Verification Engineering SA was founded in April 2002 by a team of specialists from the EDA, predominantly from Meta Systems (Mentor Graphics group). EVE has devised a revolutionary solution for the verification of integrated circuits, which can emulate code using FPGA standards. This platform helps to shorten design times for the complex integrated circuits frequently used in communication devices and more generally in all electronic devices.

EnduroSat is a space infrastructure builder that engineers, manufactures, and operates high-performance satellites, making space universally accessible for commercial and institutional customers across the globe. EnduroSat delivers end-to-end satellite missions - from mission design and payload integration to launch and in-orbit operations - through a fixed-cost, constellation-as-a-service model. EnduroSat serves 450+ customers globally and employs more than 350 space professionals across 7 locations worldwide. www.endurosat.com

Founded in 2000, Envivio specialises in MPEG4 encoding and video content delivery on mobile phones and PCs. The company provides a solution enabling TV channels and studios to deliver very high-quality videos, irrespective of the terminal’s read capacity. In 2009, Envivio introduced the first on-demand live video encoding and distribution system for the iPhone OS 3.0. The company’s headquarters are in San Francisco, California and it has offices in Rennes, London, Tokyo and Beijing.
Fibre-optic connections and internet service provider for consumers.

Iktos is an innovative company specializing in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics solutions applied to chemical research, more specifically medicinal chemistry and new drug design. The use of Iktos technology platform enables major productivity gains in upstream pharmaceutical R&D.
founders: Quentin Perron, Nicolas Do Huu and Yann Gaston-Mathé

description: Intersec designs innovative software enabling companies to leverage their Big Data. Our disruptive technology crunches and consolidates huge amounts of data coming from heterogeneous network equipment and IT, and turns them into actionable insights in real-time. Applications range from Customer Base Management, mass-scale Location-Based Services, Fraud Management and Business Analytics.

Jimmy designs and operates small modular nuclear reactors to supply its customers with decarbonised heat at a lower cost than that obtained from fossil fuels. Jimmy’s thermal generators are based on high-temperature nuclear micro-reactors (HTRs) that create the desired heat. These reactors are well-known, very hot and very safe.

Lithosquare develops an AI-powered platform designed to enhance the mining exploration process with a focus on critical minerals. Its platform is capable of ingesting a wide variety and large volumes of geological data, leveraging AI-driven geological reasoning to accelerate target identification and increase the likelihood of discovering viable prospects.

Before its acquisition by AMD, Mipsology was a French-American deeptech company founded in 2015 by FPGA veterans. The company built a strong position in AI inference software, first through advanced FPGA compilation technology and later through Zebra, its flagship platform, which enabled TensorFlow, PyTorch and ONNX models to run efficiently on AMD/Xilinx hardware without requiring model redesign. Mipsology stood out for bridging cutting-edge hardware and developer usability, helping bring high-performance inference to industrial and edge applications. By the time of the sale, it had become a respected European specialist and a long-standing AMD partner in AI software.
Founded in April 2003 by Pascal Lorne and François Colon, Miyowa is a technology enabler delivering solutions to mobile phone operators looking to add community-based services to their offering.

Founded in 2010 and based in Rambouillet, the French start-up Nanomakers has been designing and producing since 2012 patented silicon-based nanopowders which transform the mechanical, chemical or thermal properties of materials. Its disruptive technology has made it possible to triple the energy density of Li-ion batteries anodes, or to lighten and reinforce the mechanical properties of certain materials (metal alloys, elastomers) used in various industrial sectors.

German company Novaled has developed a new structure and new doping materials curbing power consumption and extending the life of organic light-emitting diodes (OLED). At the time of the sale, the company owned more than 400 patents.

Opensee is a French fintech company specializing in real-time big-data analytics for financial institutions. Its platform enables banks and market participants to query and analyze 100% of their stored data at scale, without compromising performance, volume or cost. The company addresses critical use cases such as intraday risk monitoring, trade analytics, regulatory reporting and operational efficiency. Opensee also stands out through Agensee, its agentic AI layer, which allows users to interact with risk, finance and trade data in natural language, automate complex analyses and generate explainable insights in real time. Together, this turns data complexity into a genuine competitive advantage.

OWN is a major French player in cybersecurity, providing tailor-made, informed and adapted support thanks to its DNA of passionate and committed experts. OWN is a pure player in cybersecurity, combining in-depth knowledge of the challenges facing organizations with ongoing awareness of the threats they face. They advise and contribute to the cyber defense efforts of organizations of all sizes and in all sectors, inform and alert when risk is imminent through remediation and cybersecurity improvement actions.

PARIMA is a French cultivated-protein company created through the combination of Gourmey and Vital Meat, bringing together advanced cell cultivation, avian biology, bioprocess engineering and food science. Its technology platform spans duck and chicken, uses machine learning to optimize nutrient composition and cell performance, and connects cell cultivation to finished products through predictive, data-driven scale-up. Beyond product innovation, PARIMA addresses a strategic food-security challenge: producing animal proteins in controlled environments that can strengthen supply resilience, improve traceability and reduce dependence on traditional livestock chains. With two sites in France, the company is positioning itself as a sovereign next-generation protein platform.

PeopleSpheres has developped an innovative HR PaaS (Platform as a service) that allows companies to interconect all their HR assets to built a tailor made HR platform. They integrate a large variety of best of breed software building blocks including agentic AI .

Planet A Foods is a next-generation food ingredient company focused on building future-proof, resilient alternatives for the global food industry. Founded in 2021, the company develops ingredients designed to reduce dependence on increasingly constrained and volatile agricultural inputs such as cocoa, palm oil and coffee. Its approach combines food science, industrial processing and natural raw materials to create scalable solutions for manufacturers seeking greater supply security, consistency and sustainability. By addressing both climate exposure and resource scarcity, Planet A Foods positions itself at the intersection of innovation and food-system resilience, helping brands secure long-term access to strategic ingredients in a changing world.
founders: Dr. Max and Dr. Sara Marquart

description: Proxima Fusion is a European deeptech company developing the first generation of commercial fusion power plants. Spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, Proxima leverages quasi-isodynamic stellarator technology, advanced simulations, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to turn decades of research into clean, reliable energy for the grid.

Qantev is an artificial intelligence company that helps health insurers deliver better healthcare to their members. Powered by cutting edge machine learning and optimisation to predict patient journeys, Qantev can provide unprecedented insight and automation by leveraging insurers’ historical claim data.

Qualtera was a semiconductor analytics company helping chipmakers turn vast manufacturing and test data into actionable insights. Its platform combined high-performance big-data infrastructure, real-time analytics and production-control capabilities to give engineering and operations teams visibility across test and manufacturing flows. Qualtera enabled customers to improve design implementation, accelerate yield ramps, strengthen quality control and optimize test efficiency at scale, with faster diagnosis and better operational decisions across the silicon lifecycle. The company stood out for making data-driven decision-making practical in high-volume semiconductor environments, serving industrial companies, OSATs, IDMs and foundries. Its trajectory culminated in its 2020 acquisition by Synopsys.

Co-founded in 2017 by the Professor Pascale Senellart, Dr Niccolo Somaschi and Dr Valérian Giesz, Quandela is a French company that is among the world leaders in quantum photonics. Quandela is known for being the originator of Prometheus, the world’s first photonic qubit generator with broad application domains including quantum cryptography, quantum computing or quantum sensors. The company is developping a full stack quantum computer based on its photonic technology, available on the cloud.
founders: Pascale Senellart-Mardon, Niccolo Somaschi , Valérian Giesz

description: Quantum Systems specializes in the development and production of advanced uncrewed systems, focusing on electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS) for ISR missions. The company’s family of modular, AI-enhanced platforms provides long-endurance autonomous intelligence for defense, security, and geospatial clients. Quantum Systems pursues a multi-domain approach, integrating aerial systems with ground robotics, including the Mandrill UGV and the MOSAIC Ground Autonomy Kit for coordinated air-ground operations. Leveraging edge computing, real-time AI, and open architecture, Quantum Systems delivers versatile, efficient autonomous solutions with minimal infrastructure needs. The company operates from locations in Germany (headquarters in Gilching), the United States (Moorpark, California), Australia, the United Kingdom, Romania, and Ukraine (via strategic partnerships).

Qubit Pharmaceuticals was founded in 2020 with the vision of co-developing, with pharmaceutical and biotech companies, new, more effective and safer drugs. Its software takes full advantage of existing and emerging supercomputers to model quantum effects at the microscopic level with maximum accuracy. The multidisciplinary team and founders are based in France at the Paris Santé Cochin incubator and in the United States in Boston.
founders: Robert Marino, Jay Ponder, Pengyu Ren, Louis Lagardere,

description: Highly effective open infrastructure solution for large-scale unstructured data storage

Sekoia.io specializes in the development and provision of advanced cybersecurity solutions, focusing on an AI-driven Security Operations Center (SOC) platform for detection and response. The company's platform features modular, intelligence-enhanced tools that deliver proactive threat anticipation, automated detection, and rapid response across diverse attack surfaces, serving clients in enterprises, managed security service providers (MSSPs), and public sector organizations. Sekoia.io adopts a unified, intelligence-centric approach, centering cyber threat intelligence (CTI) at the core of its offerings. This includes proprietary, real-time CTI combined with AI automation to enable comprehensive visibility and control, supporting extended detection and response (XDR) capabilities through open integrations and interoperability. The company maintains its headquarters in France (Rennes), with a European focus and operations supporting global clients.

Founded in November 2012, SeniorAdom offers new remote assistance technology. SeniorAdom’s next-generation technology automatically detects falls and sudden illness using a smart system of detectors (no cameras) connected to a central device. This central device is easy to install and use. It can simply be plugged into a power socket (no need for an internet connection because it has an embedded GSM mobile phone card). No special training is required. In addition to falls and sudden illness, SeniorAdom’s solution can also report any unusual patterns in the life of a dependent person by sending a text or email to their carer. Each carer has a personalised and secure space from which they can monitor the well-being of the person living in their own home. SeniorAdom has genuinely disrupted the remote assistance space, which had barely advanced in 35 years. It provides comfort and peace of mind to both carers and service users.

Sentryo helps organizations embrace the promises of Industry 4.0 innovations by keeping their industrial operations safe from cyber-attacks. Sentryo’s ICS CyberVision award winning platform gives control engineers comprehensive visibility on their industrial control systems, detects anomalies and accelerates response to cybersecurity incidents keeping them ahead of cyber threats. Sentryo has been acquired in 2019 by Cisco.

SeqOne Genomics offers high performance genomic analysis solutions for healthcare providers treating patients suffering from cancer, rare and hereditary diseases as well as pharmaceutical companies developing new therapies.

Skynopy helps satellite operators increase data throughput, reduce revisit times, and operate with greater agility. By combining its own infrastructure with partner ground stations and virtualized modems, Skynopy transforms ground segment complexity into a seamless service, enabling customers to focus on their missions while gaining a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving space industry.
Founded in 2003 and based in Toulouse, Solvionic produces high-purity ionic liquids, used in new generation batteries, making them more reliable, more powerful and longer lasting.

The Exploration Company’s mission is to democratize space exploration, making it affordable, available and sustainable. To realize this mission, The Exploration Company develops, manufactures and operates Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and uses green propellants. The technical bricks of Nyx are built with open interfaces: they are available on a SpaceStore to enable space & non-space companies to use them and develop new applications. Nyx provides a wide scope of missions ranging from resupplying space stations around the Earth and the Moon, free flying around Earth or landing on the Moon – and safely coming back on Earth. Nyx starts with flying cargo and has the potential to carry humans in the long run.

Founded in in 2013, by two former National Institute for Research in Digital Science and Technology (INRIA) researchers, Therapixel is a world leader in artificial intelligence applied to medical imaging. Winner of the “Digital Mammography DREAM Challenge” in 2017, Therapixel develops AI-based technology designed to help radiologists to detect breast cancer via mammograms.
Founded in 2013, the mission of Tissium is to disrupt the field of surgery and positively impact the lives of patients through the development of its platform of biomorphic programmable polymers.

Tronics Micro Systems is a spin-off from CEA Leti (French atomic energy commission’s electronics and information technology facility). The company designs, manufactures and markets high value-added MEMS (micro-electro-mechanical systems) solutions for specific applications in the medical sector, telecoms, aerospace/defence and oil exploration. The company has a presence in France, the United States and China.
The company offers services for online shops to raise customer trust thanks to a solution package combining a quality brand, a money-back guarantee and a customer feedback management service.

Unseenlabs is a French space-tech company founded in 2015, and a European leader in RF-based maritime intelligence from space. The company has developed a proprietary satellite technology capable of detecting and geolocating vessels at sea in near real time, including non-cooperative or dark ships, from a single nanosatellite. By combining in-orbit RF sensing, proprietary payloads and data-processing capabilities, Unseenlabs turns space infrastructure into actionable maritime intelligence. Its services support defence, security, fisheries monitoring, sanctions enforcement and commercial surveillance. In that sense, Unseenlabs stands out as a sovereign European space-tech platform operating at the intersection of satellite constellations, intelligence and maritime domain awareness.

VSORA is a European leader in ultra-high-performance AI inference silicon solutions. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in France, the company enables next-generation AI workloads in data centers, autonomous systems, and industrial robotics. VSORA’s global presence includes offices in Japan, Korea, Singapore, and Taiwan.

Whitelab Genomics (Paris) has developped an AI platform to speed up pre-clinical discovery and development for gene therapies. They harmonize and ingest multiple multi-omics data sources, then analyze with AI to discover targets and design payloads and vectors for gene therapy.

ZeroPhase is a European deeptech company developing sovereign, software-defined connectivity systems for unmanned platforms and critical operations. Its long-range, high-throughput data links are designed to deliver resilient, secure, and scalable communication, even in highly contested and demanding environments.
sectors: Software Defined Radios and Tactical Data Link
